title: AnalyticsDesignMetrics

distinct_projects_created_count.title: Distinct Projects Created Count
distinct_projects_created_count.description: Number of distinct Claude Design projects created. Exact in date-range mode: a creation belongs to exactly one day, so the per-day counts never overlap and their sum over the window is the exact count of distinct creations in it.

distinct_projects_used_count.title: Distinct Projects Used Count
distinct_projects_used_count.description: Number of distinct Claude Design projects the user worked in. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

distinct_session_count.title: Distinct Session Count
distinct_session_count.description: Number of distinct Claude Design sessions. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

message_count.title: Message Count
message_count.description: Number of messages sent in Claude Design sessions

description: Claude Design activity metrics for a single user on a given day.
